headline: Vir Biotechnology to Present Expanded Phase 2 SOLSTICE Results for Elebsiran and Tobevibart in Hepatitis Delta at AASLD’s The Liver Meeting 2026
summary:
Vir Biotechnology, Inc. (Nasdaq: VIR) today announced the Company will present data from the Phase 2 SOLSTICE trial evaluating the combination of elebsiran and tobevibart for chronic hepatitis delta at the upcoming American Association for the Study of Liver Diseases (AASLD) The Liver Meeting 2026 in Denver, CO, November 5-9, 2026.
Date: November 8, 2026
